notes.title: New teaser + info on development!
notes.content:
What's up, man? Howya doin? I hope ya doin good. Today, thursday, april 21st, a new teaser was uploaded, and also, new changes were revealed.

So, before going into detail, here's the teaser. It's in spanish though.

[previewyoutube=FjwQAnDpHXU;full][/previewyoutube]

It looks nice, yeah?

Well, here's the important stuff

-[b]Quests/missions are now getting implemented in-game[/b]. Base gameplay was always there, but now, we started to put the main questline + optional questlines in-game.
-[b]About 70% of the game script/dialogues are done[/b], almost all of the game is already written down (like the progression and questlines) but the some specific dialogues are still not done, but that's the current state of the game.
-[b]The design of the dungeon/first person stuff was changed[/b], before this update, the game looked more like a 3d 1bit dungeon crawler, but now, it looks more like some late 90s 3d game. This change was done mostly to make dungeons more interesting, even if it takes a bit more time to actually do them.

Here's an example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41969244/2a99769170254d8d6e1143836b15954bebdc746d.png[/img]

After some personal issues and you know, just life doing its thing in general, we now have a estimated launch date: [b]mid june.[/b]


Yeah, yeah, i know i said it was going to be out in may to a couple of people but, yeah, shit happens and now its delayed.
I am now doing this full-time, i am not working doing anything more than the game, so i really want to get this thing out, you know.

I think that's all I had to say, whatever you want to talk about, you can comment here or send a message to [url=https://discord.com/invite/h7mAGT7xDb]or discord, even though its in spanish[/url]. I'll reply to everything.

Petri.
